a.xlink:title: Reload the transfer count from handle->params.tx_size and start again.
Change the transfer length (element count) for the next transfer.
Set whether the memory address increments after each transfer and rebuild the channel configuration.
Disable the channel, stopping the transfer immediately.
Check for current SPI transaction to complete.
Write a logic value to an output pin.
Clear every latched status flag (global/complete/half/error) for one channel.
Disable a channel and block until hardware confirms it is off.
Enable a channel, starting its transfer.
True if the channel is currently enabled.
Configure CCR (data sizes, priority, increment modes, mode, ISR enables) from wiring+params.
